name: Cannabis flower and dried herb
route_basis_label: finished inhalable cannabis, product-as-tested (as sold); no reconstitution
scope_note: Inhaled route. Applicable pool = route-agnostic all-uses cannabis rules plus inhalation-specific rules (California inhalable, Colorado inhaled/nasal, Maryland inhalation). Non-inhaled route limits are not applied.
method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default, route-preserving; strictest applicable sovereign cannabis maximum; occurrence never selects a value)

iAs.rationale: iAs carries no product-specific sovereign cell; it is a component of and bounded by its parent total tAs (iAs <= tAs), an enforceable ceiling via reflex speciation rather than an empty cell.
iAs.reference_method: iAs speciation reflexed when the parent total reaches min(species limit, 50 percent of the parent-total limit); the species never substitutes for the parent-total report.

MeHg.rationale: MeHg carries no product-specific sovereign cell; it is a component of and bounded by its parent total tHg (MeHg <= tHg), an enforceable ceiling via reflex speciation rather than an empty cell.
MeHg.reference_method: MeHg speciation reflexed when the parent total reaches min(species limit, 50 percent of the parent-total limit); the species never substitutes for the parent-total report.

Ni.label: Ni 800 ug/kg: disclosed read-across from EU eu2024_ni_cereals_800 (cereals except durum/rice/husked-rice/pseudocere). Filled by the completeness sweep; nearest applicable sovereign for this matrix and basis.
Ni.substantiation: Disclosed read-across, register-verified (eu2024_ni_cereals_800). Nearest applicable sovereign Ni ceiling for this product form. Not occurrence-derived.

Sn.label: Sn 250000 ug/kg: disclosed read-across from SG sg_foodregs_2026_any_food_sn_250000 (any food). Filled by the completeness sweep; nearest applicable sovereign for this matrix and basis.
Sn.substantiation: Disclosed read-across, register-verified (sg_foodregs_2026_any_food_sn_250000). Nearest applicable sovereign Sn ceiling for this product form. Not occurrence-derived.

Al.basis: product as placed on market; dry sample, calculated as Al
Al.source_scope: baked foods (bread, pastries, cakes, biscuits, cookies, crackers); deep-fried flour products; batter, breading, and frying powder
Al.label: Al 100000 ug/kg: disclosed read-across from CN cn_gb2760_2024_al_baked_foods_100000 (baked foods (bread, pastries, cakes, biscuits, c). Filled by the completeness sweep; nearest applicable sovereign for this matrix and basis.
Al.substantiation: Disclosed read-across, register-verified (cn_gb2760_2024_al_baked_foods_100000). Nearest applicable sovereign Al ceiling for this product form. Not occurrence-derived.

Cr.screen_note: Total chromium is a screening ceiling, not a health limit: it is dominated by benign Cr(III) while the health-relevant species is Cr(VI). The value is Maryland's sovereign cannabis total-Cr action level for the inhalation route (the only sovereign cannabis program that sets total Cr). The binding health control is Cr(VI): any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails certification.
Cr.binding_control: Cr(VI) — any quantifiable Cr(VI) fails certification

Cr-VI.rationale: Cr-VI carries no product-specific sovereign cell; it is a component of and bounded by its parent total Cr (Cr-VI <= Cr), an enforceable ceiling via reflex speciation rather than an empty cell.
Cr-VI.reference_method: Cr-VI speciation reflexed when the parent total reaches min(species limit, 50 percent of the parent-total limit); the species never substitutes for the parent-total report.
